mechanism: Tolterodine is metabolized by CYP3A4 and CYP2D6; levonorgestrel may induce CYP3A4, potentially reducing tolterodine exposure, while both drugs have anticholinergic properties that may be additive.
action: Monitor for reduced tolterodine efficacy and additive anticholinergic effects (urinary retention, dry mouth, constipation); consider tolterodine dose adjustment or alternative antimuscarinic if needed.
